notes: A stream can fail without disconnecting: the transport says Live, the clock keeps advancing, and no sound comes out. Nothing in the watchdog could see that, so the meter is asked instead. Below -60 dBFS for five unbroken seconds and the lamp starts alternating amber and green -- a state you have to be told about once and then cannot mistake for either -- with the line reading "Stream detected - no audio". It then re-tunes itself after 10 seconds of silence, and again at 30, 90 and 120 seconds, which usually lands on a different server and fixes it. Four attempts and it stops, because a station that is simply off the air overnight should not be re-tuned every two minutes until morning. It can only notice this where the meter works: a station that blocks the meter has no analyser on it, so nothing is claimed. The station name on the readout holds for less time at the far end of its scroll and comes back faster, while the outward leg is unchanged to within two milliseconds -- the split-flap board is paced against that leg. A preset button's name goes out slower than it did, since it is read out of the corner of the eye. The installer stops looking alarming. It says in plain words what it is about to do before it does it, curl's seven-column transfer table is replaced by one progress bar, the shortcut script no longer talks over the installer's own account of itself, and each step is marked with a green [OK] as it completes. Settings' console thumbnail is set in the readout's own segmented face and reads 68.0 FM.
